### **Key Latin Abbreviations Used in This Document:**

* **mat. junxi / Matrimonio junxi**: "I joined in marriage"
* **coram**: "in the presence of" (preceding the names of the witnesses)
* **testantibus**: "bearing witness / being witnesses"
* **cum licentia Parochi**: "with the license of the Parish Priest"
* **Eodem die**: "On the same day"
* **P.P.**: *Parochus* (Parish Priest)
* **V.G.**: Vicar General
